stations.title: Kasimir
stations.say: The list is in a file. Read it.

stations.title: The morning
stations.text: The list copied in by hand, a count wrong.

stations.title: The stocktake
stations.text: The drawer and the notes, as on disk.

captions: Kasimir keeps the drawer list and his notes in files, and wants the program to read them.
Today he copies both into the program by hand every morning, and a count goes wrong.
You read a file line by line, add up the drawer, and read the notes, spaces and all.
The stocktake reads the files on disk, and the counts are the ones Kasimir wrote.
Kasimir's lists are read from disk now, and nobody types them in again.
